profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer and Technical Development Lead with over 20 years of experience designing and implementing web applications. I also mentor and lead effective development teams. I specialize in UI development, Enterprise Java development and application security.

I have always been a creative person. As a music-major-turned-computer-science-major, I found my passion for software development while programming music compositions. I found that coding elegant software and web pages was not much different than turning low-level performance data into beautiful music compositions, and it allowed me to be just as creative. As a software and UI developer, I still have that keen sense for detail, and I take pride in my work. As a strong proponent of test-driven development, I always strive to make my work flawless.

I began my career writing Java Swing components and applications when Java was a relatively new technology. Early in my career, I joined an agile (XP) team as an Enterprise Java developer and participated in many successful projects working with web services, interfacing with databases and mainframes, and coding web applications. I later transitioned to UI development and spent most of my development career working on the presentation side, using technologies like Adobe Flash, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including libraries and frameworks like jQuery and React). My focus in recent years has been on application security.

Throughout my career, I led many small development teams through a variety of projects and initiatives, from end-to-end application development to testing solutions with service virtualization. As a technical lead, I have often been required to come up with creative solutions to problems. However, my greatest strength as a technical lead has always been my ability to communicate and work with others. I collaborate well with business partners and technical peers alike. I have strong documentation skills which have also served me well in this role. I also understand that my success as a leader depends on the success of my team, so I do what I can to mentor and help others around me succeed. My experience as a developer also allows me to code with my development team when necessary, something I still love to do to this day.

In my free time, I like to hike, play guitar and compose music.  I'm also fascinated with sound design and sound synthesis.
